name: Kannonzaka Doppo
source:
An ordinary office worker employed at a medical equipment company.
However, his working conditions are harsh — he’s burdened with an overwhelming workload while enduring harassment from his section chief.
He’s constantly swamped with work, with overtime and weekend shifts being the norm.
Due to his extremely negative personality, he easily accumulates stress, and when it reaches its limit, his pent-up emotions explode.
He shares an apartment with Hifumi, his childhood friend since elementary school.
Although he often takes on a support role, when the situation demands it, he demonstrates real initiative and can come through to save the team.
